message: Keep the answer to Git's global hooks run tend's dispatcher on every repo where it was asked

title: Asked by vg-paradigms: Git's global hooks run tend's dispatcher on every repo
body:
Git's global hooks run tend's dispatcher on every repo (graft:01a19407-84f6..1561, from vg-paradigms)

What was needed:
- vg-paradigms: Declare git's global `core.hooksPath` for the user on every Nix machine (home-manager's programs.git), pointing to the hook dispatcher tend provides. tend is asked to build it (graft to tend: "Hooks that run a project's own checks at commit and push"). It covers pre-commit, pre-push, post-merge and post-checkout: tend's checks in a repo with .tend, nothing in one without, and always the repo's own `.git/hooks/<name>` too. This waits on tend's dispatcher; plan it now. Related: with CI off, a NixOS VM test (a flake check needing KVM) can run from any machine through Nix remote builders, a Linux machine with KVM building `checks` handed to it. If vg-dotfiles declares the builders (`nix.buildMachines` and the matching settings on the clients), the pre-push hook covers VM tests without CI.

Answer (planned): Planned in vg-dotfiles / Home / git: programs.git's global core.hooksPath on every Nix host will point at tend's dispatcher, as a switch on the git module that's on by default. This repo's pre-commit then runs nix/scripts/check.sh. The todo "Git's global core.hooksPath runs tend's hook dispatcher on every Nix machine" waits on tend's graft 01a19407-a869, which says what the dispatcher is and where it's installed. Remote builders are planned as their own todo. They wait on a bare-metal NixOS host with KVM joining the tailnet (none has yet), and the user will choose which host builds.
